blocks.content: Type two opening square brackets in a block to link to another note with autocomplete. Links to [[Welcome]] and [[Blocks and Formatting]] work like this, and renaming a note updates every link to it.
Open the **Links** tab in the right panel to see where a note points, and the **Block browser** to jump around a long note.
Names are unique across the whole notebook, so a link is always unambiguous.
